description: The opened Brussels Times story supports two same-day COVID-restriction groups: about 200 at Cinquantenaire and a separate about-200 group near Gare du Nord. The latter’s independent duration, exact demand and relationship to the first group remain less clear.
required_followup: Check only exact, permitted contemporary reports for the Gare du Nord action and distinguish group/action boundaries. Keep E002 pending evidence without merging it or borrowing facts from E001.

description: BRUZZ reports about 200 people protesting far-right politics on 3 October and includes one participant’s demand that the Belgian government prohibit an earlier Vlaams Belang gathering. The larger event focus also includes opposition to parties/ideas and the Greek Golden Dawn case.
required_followup: Reviewer should assess whether a domestic-state demand was central enough under the manual. Maintain pending_state_target; do not infer that opposition to a party automatically targets the state.

description: Sixteen real managed-search queries covered broad English/French/Dutch terms, localized and sector searches, and weekly/date windows. Returned results included out-of-month/modern pages and noisy false positives; only two distinct bodies were opened. No archive-equivalent/ LexisNexis collection was used. This is bounded open-web discovery, not an exhaustive October census.
required_followup: If expanding coverage, prioritize local Belgian-language reporting for material dates/actions not already resolved and exact-body confirmation for threshold/state-target candidates. Preserve search-only foreign-target leads and do not interpret gaps as zero events.
